Body.Content:
We’ve released a new CDN feature that allows you to preload individual assets to your CDN endpoints.  This is especially useful in a scenario where you want to pre-emptively load an asset for performance reasons, such as with a big content release.
  • For details, please read this blog post: Load feature is available for Azure CDN.
  • To learn how to pre-load your assets, see Pre-load assets on an Azure CDN endpoint.

We’ve released a new CDN feature that allows you to preload individual assets to your CDN endpoints. This is especially useful in a scenario where you want to pre-emptively load an asset for performance reasons, such as with a big content release.

For details, please read this blog post: Load feature is available for Azure CDN .

To learn how to pre-load your assets, see Pre-load assets on an Azure CDN endpoint .
